p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687674/attempts/fe7b32dd748346a8b1b7c0aebff056b5/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9f1fc1f5.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    # The four 4x4 color masks are separated by vertical columns of 3.
    # Merge them cellwise using the observed front-to-back color precedence.
    priority = (9, 4, 8, 5)
    blocks = [[row[start:start + 4] for row in grid] for start in (0, 5, 10, 15)]
    out = []
    for r in range(4):
        row = []
        for c in range(4):
            values = {block[r][c] for block in blocks}
            row.append(next((color for color in priority if color in values), 0))
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
